segments.en: We've entered Astragius.

Incoming transmission from the regular
Gilgamesh Army.

We've been cleared to dock at the port
of Gilgamesh.

Display the marker.
We're heading for Gilgamesh.

rows.notes: Seg 2 has no header; read as the NCO continuing the report.

segments.en: We've entered Astragius airspace.

Rochina, this is where you come from,
isn't it?
Yes, sir. Leave the rest to me.

The arrangements for the alliance are
already in place.
Good. Then let us be on our way.

Hey, this place is the capital of a
country called Gilgamesh, right?

Probably. Looks like the Gilgamesh Army
has its headquarters here too...
Some military people are waiting outside.
Oh? Then we'd better go say hello.
Halt!
Where is the person in charge of this fleet?
Yes, that would be me.
You are? Er, pardon me...

I am the liaison officer for the regular
Gilgamesh Army.

I'm here to inform you of the decisions
concerning your forces' future conduct.

Your forces are granted freedom of movement
within our territory. However, this comes
with conditions.
What conditions would those be?

First, even if units bearing our army's
name should engage your forces,

we ask that you acknowledge that the
regular Gilgamesh Army has nothing to do
with it.

And second, that you accept an escort of
soldiers recommended by our army.

Understood.
Thank you for your consideration.
That is all!
Hey, what was that all about?

They'll give us free run of Gilgamesh,
but they're putting a watchdog on us.

And even if a fight breaks out, the
regular army has nothing to do with it.

Even if it's the Gilgamesh Army we're
fighting?

It seems to be a huge military... Maybe
its chain of command doesn't reach
everywhere.

If we make one wrong move, they can erase
us with no loose ends... That's what
the watchdog is for, right?

Looks like this continent's got all kinds
of trouble of its own...

rows.notes: Segs 1, 4-6, 9-10 have no header: the Gilgamesh Officer continuing. Seg 16 no header: Nelfea continuing. | [editorial 19] 'without leaving a mess' -> idiomatic 'with no loose ends' ([jp])

segments.en: Yo!
Hm? Who are you?
I've just been assigned here.

Could you put me through to whoever's
in charge of the fleet?

Yeah, we heard you were coming.
Hang on a sec.

Keek... Are you sure about this?
I mean, me...

Don't worry about it!
I've already taken care of everything.
Come on, just leave it to me!

Captain Rie, looks like our guests
are here.

All right. Then let's have them come
up to the bridge.

Name's Keek Caradine.
Thanks for having me.
And this guy here is...

Mellowlink Arity...
Good to meet you.

I'm Rie Akatsuki, the fleet commander.
It's a pleasure to meet you.

Still, there sure are a lot of young
faces on this ship...

Um, the roster only lists you, Keek...
What about Mellowlink...?

Oh, uh, sorry.
Here are the orders.

See, I begged the higher-ups at the last
minute. Didn't feel too sure going in
alone.

Besides, this guy's useful in real combat.
Use him however you like.
O-Okay...

Sorry...
Looks like I've caused you some trouble.
No, it's fine, really.
Our fleet never turns anyone away!
Heh... Appreciate it.
Mellow and Keek have joined the unit.

rows.notes: Seg 6: Mellowlink's '[jp]...' trails off; read as worry about his own unlisted assignment. Lun's [jp]/[jp] rendered with bare names (Keek's gender is unrecorded, so no Mr./Ms.). Segs 8, 12, 18-19 no header: Keek continuing. | [editorial 20] style sheet: stutter repeats the capital | [editorial 24] 'That's a help' stiff; Keek's casual [jp]

segments.en:
We're approaching Balarant-controlled
territory.

Emergency transmission from the
Balarant Army!
This is a warning!

Our nation is currently in a state of
tension with the Gilgamesh Army.

Should your forces enter our territory,
we will regard you as hostile and attack.

Looks like getting into Balarant is still
too hard for now...

We'll need some organization to mediate
and smooth the way for us first.

Change course!
We're leaving Balarant airspace.

Looks like getting into Balarant is still
too hard for now...
Changing course!

We've entered Balarant-controlled
territory.

Emergency transmission from the
Balarant Army!
We have received word from GAIL.

Your forces are granted permission to
dock at "Balarant" and "GAIL Town."

Rod Balboa here. So we're free to carry
out our survey in Austral airspace?

Of course.
Do as you please.

However, our nation remains in a state
of tension with Gilgamesh.

Therefore, should any unit mistake your
forces for the enemy, our army will not
acknowledge it.
Is that acceptable?
Understood.
Then, that is all!
You can now enter Balarant.

rows.notes: [jp] not in glossary: 'GAIL Town' (GAIL as the company is spelled elsewhere).

segments.en:
We're getting a transmission from the
Deloyer government.
Can you put it through?
Yes!

This city is administered by the
Deloyer Autonomous State.

I'm sorry, but I must ask you to refrain
from docking.

We have permission from the regular
Gilgamesh Army.
Couldn't we at least resupply?
Not at present, I'm afraid.

The truth is, guerrillas demanding
Deloyer's independence keep appearing,
so we have declared martial law.
Hence, I must ask you not to dock.
I see...
It's quite embarrassing...

Once things have settled down, I would
be delighted to invite you all.

Understood. We'll put in at another
city instead.

I wish you a safe voyage.
Farewell.
Rie... that man...
What is it, Lun?

That Lecoque fellow... He seems to be
hiding something...
Yeah...

He might have some connection to the
Redros Army...

Deloyer, huh... Isn't there some way we
could sneak in...

Looks like they slammed the door in
your face.

We've got the Gilgamesh Army's seal of
approval and everything... No dice.

Hahahaha!
Well, don't be like that.

That place has had all kinds of trouble
with the independence uproar...

Word is Lecoque, who was sent from the
capital, set up some political deals.
So we can't get in for a while?

Isn't cutting your way in exactly what
you people do?

That Redros Army you're after has ties
to the regular Gilgamesh Army too.

Though, same as with you lot, the
official answer is NO.
What did you say?

Easy. You don't want to sour things with
Gilgamesh, do you?

More importantly, have you heard that
the Deloyer 8th Army is attacking the
Brave Continent?
The Deloyer 8th Army...?

The Gilgamesh Army's still locked in a
standoff with the Balarant Army.

So in the middle of all this, they tried
to use the Deloyer forces to expand their
reach.

So that's why the 8th Army made its
move...

But the Brave Continent fought back
harder than expected.

So the Deloyer forces started cutting
back-room deals with the Redros Army.

Once that happens, the regular Gilgamesh
Army can't just look the other way.

Got to stop the kid from rebelling
against the parent before it happens.

So that's why Gilgamesh wanted ties
with our fleet?
Yeah, something like that.

Anyway, something stinks about what
Deloyer's up to right now.

If you go to Brave, you might just dig
up something on them.
I see. Thanks.

Nah.
It's all part of the job.

rows.notes: Seg 25 [jp] rendered 'the capital' (central government). Seg 36: subject left as 'they' -- read as Gilgamesh using the Deloyer forces (Kanji's reply and seg 41's parent/child image support it). Seg 37 source typo [jp] read as [jp]. [jp] -> Brave Continent (as in existing place-name strings). Segs 4, 8-9, 12 no header: Lecoque continuing. | [accuracy 16] Rie says [jp]; project decision: 'Miss Lun' from those who use the honorific (Rie uses 'Miss Lun' in most other units) | [editorial 44] 'Deloyer's moves stink' awkward; natural idiom for [jp] (suspicious) | [editorial 45] accuracy flag: [jp] = find some evidence; 'catch them by the tail' lost the 'something/evidence' sense

segments.en:
We haven't been granted permission to
dock at Deloyer.
Please change course.

Hey, Crinn.
How's the Dougram doing?
Good. I just finished the maintenance.

You were out somewhere, J. Locke.
Where'd you go?
Oh, here and there.

But this time I came back with something.
I've found out what became of Dr. Samarin.
What?!

The doctor is being held prisoner, but
is safe, at any rate.
So? Where's the doctor now?
At the Deloyer Army's home base.
Then, in Deloyer's capital?

That's right.
We'll have to go in fully prepared.

Heh...
This is it, then.

I'm going to the bridge. I need them to
add Deloyer to the fleet's list of
targets.
...And that's the situation.

Dr. Samarin is the source of the Deloyer
Liberation Front's cause, and is deeply
trusted by the people.

If we can rescue the doctor, we'll win
the support not only of Deloyer, but of
many other people as well.

I'd very much like you to put this
operation into action.

Understood. I'll set Deloyer as one of
the fleet's capture targets.
Lun!

Roger!
Displaying a marker on Deloyer.

The Deloyer capture operation has
begun.

rows.notes: Seg 3 '[jp]' is labelled Crinn Cashim in the data but is clearly J. Locke answering Crinn's question; translated as J. Locke. Dr. Samarin's gender is blank in speakers.tsv, so 'the doctor' is used instead of he/she. Seg 14: [jp] read as a typo for [jp] (trust/esteem). [jp] rendered literally as 'Deloyer Liberation Front' (not in glossary). | [accuracy 18] Rie's [jp] -> 'Miss Lun' per project decision | [editorial 18] late decision: Rie's [jp] = plain 'Lun' (page has no header but is Rie continuing; a speaker-based script would miss it)

segments.en: We'll reach Deloyer soon.

We must settle things with Von Stein,
and with Lecoque.

Man, it's amazing we've fought our
way this far.
All right, let's do this!
Impossible! My 8th Army...

I'm no general from 200 years ago, but
allow me to say it anyway:
"I shall return!"

rows.notes: Lecoque quotes MacArthur's 'I shall return' (written in katakana English in the source).

segments.en:
The Deloyer 8th Army has withdrawn from
the city.
Message from the Infantry Squad.

Enemy resistance was extremely light.
No losses on our side.

Dr. Samarin has also been rescued
safely.
Set alert status to Level C.
We're docking at Deloyer.

rows.notes: [accuracy 4] 'Lower' was an added detail; source only says 'alert status to Level C' | [editorial 1] UI term: [jp] = 'Infantry Squad' (capitalised, as in the rest of the corpus) | [editorial 5] project term: [jp] = 'dock'

segments.en:
Hello there.
You're looking well.

Doctor!
It's been so long!!

You've grown into a fine young man,
Crinn.

Word of the Fang of the Sun reached us
even here.

Heheh!
Guess we're kind of famous now.

Doctor, I apologize for taking so long
to rescue you.
Thank you, J. Locke.

If you hadn't held the unit together,
our movement would have collapsed.
But the fighting is far from over.

Yes...
Unfortunately, it seems that way.

I'm worried this battle might hurt our
relationship with the Gilgamesh Army.

Deloyer was one of Gilgamesh's
autonomous states, after all...

Yeah. In the end, it looks like we took
Deloyer by force. No way the Gilgamesh
Army won't be wary of us.
You needn't worry about that.

The Gilgamesh military is enormous.
It was broad-minded enough to welcome
your fleet into its capital...

That's true...
Honestly, it surprised me.

Keek, you're there, aren't you? I imagine
you know the situation well?

Ha ha, you got me.
You see right through everything.

That's right. To the Gilgamesh Army, the
Deloyer forces hardly matter.

But once the Redros Army and the 8th Army
teamed up on their own, they had to be
kept in check.

Well, it got a little rough, but it looks
like the Gilgamesh Army will turn a blind
eye to this one.

Ugh, spare me... Political games, huh...
I'm sure they've got all kinds of
reasons, though.

Now, let's get to the point.
It was about the Redros Army, yes?
Yes. Do you have any information?

Hmm. At first glance, it may seem we're
free to move as we like in this country.
But the same goes for the Redros Army.

In other words, the Redros Army's moves
are being camouflaged.
Exactly.

I was locked up, so I haven't gotten
hold of any concrete information myself.

But while I was being held, a young man
named Chirico came to see me.

I feel I glimpsed the Redros Army's
shadow behind whatever he's chasing.
Then if we go after this Chirico...
Chirico is most likely in "Uoodo."

If you can make contact with him, you may
learn something.
And I'm sure he will cooperate with us.

Then let's hurry.
To Uoodo!

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Uoodo' (spelling already used in the character library entries; not in glossary). | [accuracy 23] object restored: [jp] = make contact with him (Chirico)

segments.en: Displaying a marker on "Uoodo."
We've arrived at Uoodo.
So Chirico's here...
If it's a search, leave it to my unit.

Right.
We're counting on you.

A Gilgamesh Army battleship is
approaching!

Hm?
That's odd...

Its formation's different from the
regular army units deployed in this area.

All ships!
Go on alert!
Is that our target this time?
Looks like it.

Let's show them what the Red Shoulders
can really do -- a souvenir to take to
the grave.
Roger that!

rows.notes: [editorial 10] tacked-on fragment 'Something to take with them to the grave' smoothed; keeps the [jp] image

segments.en: Heh... They've walked into the net.

All right!
Don't let a single one get away!
A new unit has entered the combat zone!

Lock on to the target! Link tactical
data to the combat squads!

Wait!
That's not an enemy!
Huh?

I'm Chirico Cuvie.
I need to talk to you.

So you're Chirico. That saves us the
trouble of looking for you.

But talk can wait! Right now we deal
with the enemy in front of us!

Understood...
I'll lend a hand...

rows.notes: [editorial 0] 'They're in the net' flat; natural trap phrasing ([jp]) | [editorial 8] 'talking comes later' stiff

segments.en:
Mellow...!
Those guys are Red Shoulders!

I heard that unit was disbanded after
the Battle of Sunsa...

Looks like their old boss gathered the
survivors and is up to something.
Don't get in too deep.
I can't do that...

Whoa, hey, you're seriously going to
take those guys on?
I'll survive this...
I still have something I have to do.

Heh...
Then I'll be looking forward to it.

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'the Battle of Sunsa' (Sunsa as in the library entries).

segments.en:
Impossible! We're supposed to be the
strongest soldiers there are!
His Excellency's plan can't fail!
Don't you get it?

You've all been...
abandoned by Pailsen!
Th-That's a lie!

Surrender. This fight is already
decided.
Ngh...
Gwaaaaah!!
Did that one do it?!

You bastard!
What are you doing!!
Die...
Waaaaah!!
Those reflexes...!

That machine!
It attacked its own men?!

Not even letting us take prisoners...
That's ruthlessly thorough...

rows.notes: Seg 9 [jp]: Chirico does not yet know who the pilot is, so 'that one'. Seg 13 [jp] rendered 'reflexes' (reaction speed). Seg 1 [jp] = Pailsen ('His Excellency'). | [editorial 4] style sheet: stutter repeats the capital

segments.en:
Enemy unit...
wiped out...
Wiped out... Damn it all...
We're docking at Uoodo...

rows.notes: [editorial 3] project term: [jp] = 'dock'

segments.en: "Operations Room"

That blue AT...
Those were no ordinary moves.
Wasn't that one the real Red Shoulder?

No...
That was a PS.
A PS?
A Perfect Soldier.

The perfect soldier dreamed up by
Pailsen, founder of the Red Shoulders.

Didn't think they were still pushing
that research...

The Redros Army was among their
sources of funding.

The enemy you're after should be there
too.
You know where Pailsen is?
I have a rough idea.

But first, go to "Kummen."
An old comrade of mine is there.
Oh? Didn't think you had comrades...

...They're ex-Red Shoulders.
I'd like to bring them along if I can.
I don't mind, but why?
They're tracking Pailsen too.

Combined with the leads I have, we
should be able to pin down where the
base is.

I see.
Then our course is set.
Chirico has joined the unit.
Chirico's Scopedog has been deployed.

Lun, we've decided our next destination.
Please add "Kummen" to our objectives.
Roger!
Displaying a marker on "Kummen."

rows.notes: [jp] / [jp] -> 'PS' (Perfect Soldier). Seg 12 [jp] kept singular per the Japanese; seg 14 reveals they are several. | [accuracy 21] Rie's [jp] -> 'Miss Lun' per project decision | [accuracy 14] subject/verb restored: Chirico is answering Keek about his comrades | [editorial 1] accuracy flag: 'moved like no ordinary pilot' mixed machine and pilot; [jp] is about the movement

segments.en: We're almost at Kummen, right...?
Multiple moving targets confirmed!

Units are deploying!
Incoming fire!!

Halt! We cannot let you pass beyond
this point.

Heh heh! Orders from above.
No hard feelings!
Chirico, what's going on here?

That's the enemy.
We'll drive them off!
That's not what I meant...!

This is a mercenary base. It gets used
a lot for off-the-books operations.

Means Pailsen's got a lot of pull
inside the military...

Looks like someone pulled strings
ahead of us.
Yeah...

We're taking the base!
Let's go!!

Hehhehheh!
I'll crush you!

First wave!
Advance!!
Here they come!!

Kanji,
give me a moment.
Gregore, can you hear me?

Well, well!
If it isn't Chirico!

Chirico?!
You're alive?!
I heard you'd all be gathering here...

Heh... There's no way you'd die.
I figured you'd show up.

Still, you brought quite a crowd with
you.

Who cares? Anyway, now the whole gang's
here.
We're done with this place.
Shall we?

Heh! Our first party in ages!
Let's make it a big one!!

Y-You bastards!
Traitors get shot!!

Heh...!
Like we care!

rows.notes: [editorial 14] style sheet: stutter repeats the capital

segments.en:
Grrrr!!
Those bastards!!

We're at a disadvantage like this.
Fall back for now!
Enemy units are retreating.
No threats in the vicinity.

Chirico, you're saying we team up with
this fleet?

Right now, this unit is short on AT
pilots.

To form an AT squad, we need skilled
instructors.

So you want to hire us ex-Red Shoulders,
huh?

But that'd throw off the plan we've been
putting together.

If you're after Pailsen, this is the
right place to be.

The organization backing him worries
me... It's more than we can handle on
our own.

I see.
So that's how it is.
I'm fine with it.

If it means I get to kill him, I'd shake
hands with the devil himself.

Byman...
What about you?

Heh...
Chirico's vouching for it. I'm in.

Heh!
Then it's settled!

Chirico, we're counting on you for the
rest!
Yeah...

Gregore and the others have joined the
unit, and an AT training squad has been
formed.
You can now train AT pilots.

rows.notes: Seg 5 source typo [jp] [jp] read as [jp]. Seg 6 [jp] read as [jp].

segments.en:
Chirico, have you pinpointed the enemy
base?

Yeah...
Enter these coordinates.

Got it.
Marking those coordinates now.
It's closer than I thought...

This will probably be a fierce battle.
Make sure you're fully prepared.
Got it.
Enemy unit spotted!
All ships, battle stations!!

So you've sniffed us out...
Chirico...

Proto One, Epsilon.
You know what to do?

Eliminate Chirico.
That's all.
Good.

It's time.
I'm heading out!
Ah, Epsilon...!

Proto One! In this battle, you will cut
away the illusions you hold about
Chirico.

What are you doing! Without our
protection, you don't even have a
reason to exist!
Go, and carry out your duty!
...Understood.
It seems Proto One is incomplete.

Yes... She came into contact with
Chirico before she awakened.

But it's had a good effect on Epsilon's
development.

Stoking his rivalry with Chirico to
speed up his completion as a PS,
I take it.

However, as the data shows, Chirico's
latent ability is immeasurable.

Can Epsilon, as he is now, really stand
up to him, I wonder?

It's time I returned to the fleet.
I'll be taking my leave.

Oh, and one more thing. This base will
have to be abandoned. Hurry the
withdrawal along.
Naturally. That was my intention.
Then the rest goes as arranged.
Epsilon can't beat Chirico...?

How much does he know about Chirico's
secret...?

Chirico Cuvie...
That man is a dangerous being.

rows.notes: Seg 25 [jp] = Rochina (Pailsen musing after Rochina leaves). Seg 14 'She' = Proto One (Fyana, female per glossary). | [editorial 26] accuracy flag: 'a dangerous existence' stiff; 'being' keeps [jp]

segments.en:
Your Excellency! It's too dangerous to
stay any longer! We must withdraw!!

Hurry and recover Epsilon!
What happened to Proto One?!

Epsilon has returned to the ship.
But Proto One's whereabouts are unknown!
Mmh...

It can't be helped...
We're abandoning Proto One!
Withdrawing!!

rows.notes: Seg 0 [jp] rendered 'Your Excellency' (name dropped to fit natural address). Seg 4 [jp] read as [jp]. | [editorial 4] 'We abandon Proto One' stilted as a spoken order

segments.en: The enemy fleet is retreating.

We'll investigate the base.
Prepare to dock.

We'll begin investigating the base.
Survey staff, proceed as instructed.
I know, chief!
Maybe I'll go take a look too...

rows.notes: Seg 0 [jp] read as [jp].

segments.en: Hm?

That thing over there...
Isn't that an AT?!

Well, well... This one still looks
usable.
Let's haul it in!
Right!
Kanji, leave this one to us.
Yeah, I'm counting on you.

Machine recovered:
Blood Sucker

rows.notes: System line [jp] uses 'Machine recovered:' (modelled on the 'Machine added:' format; [jp] = recovered). | [editorial 6] 'thanks a lot' can read sarcastic; [jp]

segments.en: Hm? There's an AT over there...!
This one's usable.
Let's haul it out of here, quick!
Kanji, leave the rest to us.

Yeah, you're right.
I'll leave it to you.

Machine recovered:
Scopedog RSC

Fyana! It's me!
Wake up!
Ah... Chirico...

Let's go... You're not Pailsen's
puppet anymore.
Yes...

Chirico, what's wrong?
Who's that?
It's Fyana...

...She looks really weak.
Let's get her to sickbay, quick.
Sorry...

Knock it off!
It's the least we could do.
Come on, let's go!
Sickbay's this way.
Yeah...

Are you all right,
Fyana?
Let's hurry...
Right.
"Sickbay"
So what else do we need to do?
We need Jijirium.

Jijirium, huh... I can arrange it, but...
this much is gonna cost a fortune.

I have money I've saved up all this time.
Use all of it.

And you can put every bit of the pay
I get from this fleet toward it, too.

Whoa, whoa. You don't have to shoulder
that on your own.

Fyana is a PS. A prototype PS
created by Pailsen...

Huh?
She is?

Keeping a PS's body alive takes a huge
amount of Jijirium... So that's it...
Yeah...

And? Once she's revived,
what are you going to do with her?

I want you to keep her here
until this fight is settled...

I know it's a lot to ask. But I'll work
hard enough to make up for it.
Don't worry about that.

This ship can take Fyana in.
You just carry on like you have been.
It'll be fine.
I see... Thank you.
Fyana has joined the unit.
Brutishdog has been deployed.
An alarm?!

Sounds like something's happened
outside...
I'm going to the bridge!!

What's going on?!
What happened?!

Word is the Balarant Army has launched
military action at Sunsa.
They broke the ceasefire agreement?
Looks like it...

I don't know what set it off,
though...

A fleet, probably hostile, is deploying!!
It'll be over this base any moment!

Prepare for launch!!
Hurry!!

If we "Depart," there'll be a battle.
We need to get ready with that in mind.
Yes, I know!

rows.notes: Jijirium ([jp]) is not in the glossary: romanized 'Jijirium'. Seg 22 [jp] rendered 'Thank you' (gratitude for taking Fyana in). Seg 24 [jp] = glossary Brutishdog. Seg 21 [jp] read as 'no need to pay or change anything; carry on as before'.

segments.en:
(Balarant's fleet attacking a Gilgamesh
base... The wider the fires of war
spread, the better.)

Attention, all forces! We will wipe the
Gilgamesh base off the map!
Battle stations!

Charge!
Drive off the enemy defense fleet!!

rows.notes: Seg 1 has no header; taken as Rochina (now commanding the Balarant attack). [jp] rendered as the fires of war spreading wide.

segments.en:
Heh...
This is as far as it goes.

But the strategic objective
has been achieved.

Commander Rochina!
You must escape!!
I'm coming!
The remaining enemy fleet is retreating!

But now this continent is going
to be plunged into war...

As usual, it looks like Rochina
was pulling the strings...

Damn it! So in the end it all went
the way the Redros Army wanted!

The Hundred Years' War, huh...
It was only ever a short ceasefire
after all...

This war couldn't have been stopped.
It just started a little sooner,
that's all.

Unless we cut it off at the root,
the fighting will never end.
Yeah, that's right...

So where all that Jijirium ended up,
there was PS research waiting.

The platoon I was in
was sacrificed for it.

But that battle is still erased
from the military's records.

To give priority to shipping a huge load
of Jijirium stolen from Balarant,

the top brass abandoned a certain
platoon on the front line.

And that was your platoon,
the Schweps Platoon...

The whole platoon was wiped out--
all except me.

But you know, it'd be wrong
to hold it against Chirico or Fyana.

I know that.
The enemy I have to bring down
is somebody else.

I heard everything. I'll lend you
a hand, Mellow!

Heh... I lost my arm, and this guy
even had his family taken from him.
All for the sake of that project.

Stick with this fleet, and we might get
to finish them all off in one go.

The PS project... and the bastards
who started this idiotic war!

Hey, Mellow, how about forming
a platoon with us?

Do that, and the Schweps Platoon
might rest a little easier.
Gregore...

That deal... Mind if I get
a piece of it too?

Heh... The intelligence man, huh?
Guess you'd be Carson's replacement.

Heh!
Ain't that the truth!
Carson?
Yeah, an old buddy of ours.
Anyway, let's all get along!
The Bottoms Platoon has been formed.
Members' AT levels have risen by 5.

rows.notes: Seg 18 [jp] (whose family was taken) is not named; kept as 'this guy' (probably Murza, beside Byman). Seg 20 continues Gregore's [jp]... sentence; [jp] rendered 'the bastards' to carry Mellowlink's anger -- could be the neutral 'the ones'. Seg 30 [jp] -> 'Bottoms Platoon' (library uses 'Bottoms' for the slang); not in glossary. Carson per glossary (Virgil Carson, intelligence spy in the Red Shoulders). | [accuracy 1] tense: [jp] is about to happen (the enemy fleet has only just retreated), not already done | [accuracy 4] subject restored and [jp] (it was only ever) carried | [editorial 31] plural agreement / natural system line

segments.en:
Austral Island is Balarant-controlled
territory. We can't enter it right now.
Changing course!

GAIL Town is on the shore
across from Austral Island.
That's one big dome...

It's a fortress city GAIL built to
survey Austral. And they made me chief
of the branch there.

Things'll be more flexible for us there.
Head for the town first.

rows.notes: [editorial 2] 'I got made chief' awkward | [editorial 3] accuracy flag: 'bend the rules' added a rule-breaking nuance; [jp] = accommodating/flexible

segments.en:
Before we go into Austral,
stop by GAIL Town.
Changing course.

rows.notes: [editorial 0] 'Before... first' redundant

segments.en:
Transmission from GAIL Town!
It's for you, Rod.
Can you put it through right away?
Sure.

Chief!
We've got trouble!!

What's this all of a sudden?!
We're getting ready to dock.
Make it quick.

This can't wait! A huge army of
humanoids is closing in from the
center of the island!!

What are you panicking for!
What about the tank corps?!

We hit them with concentrated fire,
but they didn't even flinch!!

The Horse's Saddle defense line
has been broken!!
...What?

I'm on my way!
Hold out until I get there!!
R-Roger!!

GAIL Town is still standing.
Dock there and regroup.

Understood.
We'll put in at GAIL Town!

rows.notes: Speaker header 'HOLD Trooper' is a reused portrait; the caller is a GAIL Town trooper addressing Rod as [jp] ('Chief', branch chief). [jp] not in glossary: 'Horse's Saddle' (place name, literal). | [editorial 11] style sheet: stutter repeats the capital

segments.en: Kanji...
What's wrong, Lun?

I feel... a terrible... chill...
The feel of this enemy...
I've felt it once before...

No way...
The Mediator?

I don't know... But...
what's beyond Austral's gate...
is probably close to it...

So we're finally closing in
on the core, huh?
Kanji, be careful...

Don't be fooled by
how they look...

Got it.
Thanks, Lun.
If you depart, a battle will begin.

rows.notes: Seg 3 [jp] per glossary (Mediator, kind: ship).

segments.en: The enemy's right on top of us!!
GAIL's private army is in trouble!!
We're going into battle immediately!

The defense line is still holding.
Can we push them back from here?
Let's do our best.

Guardians, rain the lightning of
judgment down upon these
foolish humans.
What's that blue machine...!

Don't shoot!
That one's on our side...!

She's right... Looks like that
blue one's been holding
the defense line...

That's...!
Yuu's Gorg!!

Yuu, were you protecting this place
with Gorg?

...You've got some nerve!
You're unbelievable...!

After all the hell you put me and Gorg
through, now you want to rely on us...
That's way too convenient!

Sorry...
I had no other choice.

You're a terrible person!
You opened the gate
with your dirty dealings!

And because of that, something
terrible is about to happen!!

Kid! I don't know a thing
about the gate!!

That was something
my old man started!

It's all the same!
You people are all the same!

Is it because I'm here
that you won't help us, Yuu...?
...I'll fight.

But I'm not fighting for you!
Don't you ever forget that!
Yuu and Gorg have joined the unit.

rows.notes: Seg 5 'She's right' refers to Lun (female). Seg 6 [jp] reading gloss dropped. Seg 14 [jp] kept as 'my old man' as written (Rod's library entry names his grandfather as GAIL chairman). | [editorial 8] accuracy flag: [jp] is exasperation, not a comparison ('of all people') | [editorial 11] style sheet: 'gate' lowercase (common noun) | [editorial 13] style sheet: 'gate' lowercase (common noun)

segments.en: Insolent humans...

One day you will come to know
the greatness of Galfa.

That wasn't the end of it...
That was nothing...!

The remaining enemies are falling back
into the mountains.

No enemies in the air! We can approach
the area around the gate!

Are we charging straight into the gate?
There's space on the other side.

Space, huh... Then I'd better
adjust our squad setup...

rows.notes: Seg 3 [jp] is not in quotes here, so written as plain 'squad setup' (UI 'Squad Setup'). | [editorial 1] style sheet: 'gate' lowercase (common noun) | [editorial 2] style sheet: 'gate' lowercase (common noun)

segments.en: Infantry Squad spotted on the ground!
Enemies, in a place like this?
Maybe they're guarding something...

rows.notes: [editorial 0] UI term: [jp] = 'Infantry Squad' (capitalised, as in the rest of the corpus)

segments.en: Enemy forces repelled.
Docking at Sai Village.

rows.notes: [jp] not in glossary: romanized 'Sai Village'.

segments.en:
This place must be some kind
of ruins, I guess...

Yeah... This is the entrance
to the ruins of Manon's people.

It's all blocked off now,
though...
Who's Manon?

The leader of the people who
built the Guardians.

They had way more advanced science
than us.

Manon and the others came to Austral
tens of thousands of years ago, and
they've been asleep ever since.

Until GAIL came and tore up
this island, anyway...

Then that huge army of Guardians
was Manon's doing?
No, that wasn't them.

Manon's not here
anymore...

Some other aliens took over
the Guardians.
So that's how it was...

(Other aliens, huh...
 Maybe... the Mediator...)

Ah!
That's...!

Whoa! Isn't that
a Guardian?!

It's okay. Looks like it
can't move right now.

I'll have Gorg carry it
to the ship.

I see.
Then I'll leave it to you!
Guardian recovered.

rows.notes: [jp] not in glossary: romanized 'Manon'; gender unknown, so no pronouns used for Manon. Seg 5 'than us' added to complete the comparison ([jp]). | [accuracy 1] [jp] restored: the ruins belong to Manon's group, not Manon alone (sets up 'leader' in k4)

segments.en: We're closing in on the pillar of light.
Space at last.

Huh?
What is this?!
What's wrong?
Something huge is coming out!!
What the heck is that?!

This is far too conspicuous.
Isn't it still too early?

Those people cannot be
allowed through.

That is the only reason I summoned
the Spiral Castle.
Kanji, can you hear me!

As you are now, you're no match for it.
Go back and try again!

Omega! So you're mixed up
in this after all!

Big Bro...
Is our squad setup okay?
Not really...

That fortress doesn't seem inclined
to move from there...

The only way through the gate is to
destroy it, but there's no need to rush.

Let's work out a solid plan
before we attack.
Roger!
The Spiral Castle is blocking the gate.

Approaching it will start a battle,
so get ready before you go in.

rows.notes: Seg 10 [jp] is used in its common (inverted) sense: 'you're no match for it'. Seg 13 [jp] rendered 'Not really...' (Kanji admitting the setup isn't ready). | [editorial 0] 'We've approached' stiff | [editorial 15] style sheet: 'gate' lowercase (common noun) | [editorial 18] style sheet: 'gate' lowercase (common noun)

segments.en: Approaching the Spiral Castle!!
Spiral Castle destroyed.
You can now pass through the gate.

rows.notes: [editorial 1] style sheet: 'gate' lowercase (common noun); passive smoothed to match 'You can now enter Balarant.'

segments.en: We're approaching Deloyer.

This is the capital of the Deloyer
Autonomous State. Preparations for
the alliance are complete.

Good!
Take us in.

We've been expecting you,
Commander Rochina.

I am also an officer
of Gilgamesh.

Support for Deloyer, as our province,
will only grow stronger.

But Gilgamesh headquarters says it
can't spare any forces. Are you sure
this will be all right?
I imagine it would say that...

The ceasefire treaty with Balarant may
still be in effect, but tension between
the two nations is rising.

However, there's no need
for concern.

The Redros Army's forces alone should
take the Brave Continent with ease.

I'm relieved to hear it. The Deloyer
government will spare no effort
in cooperating with you.

We have secured solid connections with
the multinational corporation GAIL.

Thanks to that, supplies to the
expeditionary force are flowing
without delay.

GAIL also has strong influence
over Brave's media.

It will come in handy for steering
public opinion once the Brave
Continent is ours.

Heh... With you in charge, it seems
everything will go smoothly.
Leave it to me.
Alliance formed with the Deloyer Army.

rows.notes: Seg 2 [jp]: 'as our province' (Rochina speaking as a Gilgamesh officer).

segments.en:
This is Odon Base. Pailsen and his Red
Shoulder unit are hiding out here.

Very well.
I leave the rest to you.
Understood.

rows.notes: [jp] not in glossary: romanized 'Odon Base'.

segments.en:
You seem to have settled nicely into
your work with the Redros Army.

The Jijirium arrangements have all
gone through without a hitch.

Please use it as Your Excellency
sees fit.
What's going on?

Commander!!
An unidentified AT unit is approaching!

It seems they've sniffed out
the base's location.

Wipe them all out, and the matter
is settled!

Someone may be behind them. As a
precaution, wouldn't it be wise to move
your facilities to the fleet?

I've already prepared
replacement facilities.

Impressive.
Then I'll take you up on it.

But first, allow me to show you
the power of the PS I raised.
Pailsen's organization has joined up.
Epsilon and Fyana have joined the unit.
If you "Depart," a battle will begin.

Enemy unit spotted!
We are now entering combat!
Enemy unit destroyed!

Hmph!
Not even worth our time.

A new proposal has come in
from the operations unit.

We have successfully made contact with
Yoran Pailsen, founder of the Red
Shoulder unit.

From now on, our army can train
AT (Armored Trooper) pilots.
Well done.

Training pilots is the very foundation
of an army.

Keep doing your utmost to expand
our army's strength.
Sir!
An AT training squad has been formed.
You can now train AT pilots.

rows.notes: [editorial 6] 'work that forms the very core' wordy

segments.en: Arrived at Kummen.

Commander Rochina, what business
brings you here this time?

I want soldiers. I'll buy them--along
with everything this base can do.
Straight to the point, I see.

The date of the operation is drawing
near. I expect swift arrangements.

Leave it to me.
I'll have them prepared at once.

The EX-10 mercenaries have joined
the unit.

rows.notes: Seg 5: EX-10 = Assemble EX-10 (glossary position text). | [editorial 3] [jp] is the operation date, not a 'deadline'; smoother

segments.en:
Negotiations with the Balarant
government are already complete.

We will launch a joint operation
with the Balarant Army.

Allying with Balarant... What's the
Commander trying to do...
You don't get it?

The Astragius Continent is ruled by two
mighty nations, Gilgamesh and Balarant.

Until just recently, the two were at
war for 100 years, but right now
they're in a ceasefire.
So?

We're going to have these two great
powers fight each other. That's all.

The Balarant Army has launched an
attack on Sunsa. Our army will join
the campaign.

rows.notes: Seg 2 [jp] = Rochina (he holds the title Commander), addressed by role.

segments.en:
Enemy fleet approaching! Our fleet
will be in engagement range soon too!

This fight is just a favor
to Balarant.
Don't push yourself, Kanji.
Roger!

Sunsa has been taken.
Victory goes to the Balarant Army.

With this, the war between the two
nations is back to square one.
Mm, splendid.
On to the next operation.
Sir!
Hm?

What is it? Is there something
out here in this backwater?

Zero has found something
interesting.
Zero of Galfa, eh...

You called for me,
Lord Redros?
So what is it that's out here?

The ones who opened the gate in this
land tens of thousands of years ago...
I have obtained their legacy.

Oh...
How very interesting.

Allow me to show you. If it pleases
you, I would ask you to accompany me.
Very well.

rows.notes: Seg 4 [jp] -> 'Lord Redros' (Zero's formal address to Redros Binzvanker). | [editorial 5] 'What is here, then?' awkward | [editorial 6] style sheet: 'gate' lowercase (common noun)

segments.en:
Behold. A weapon such as this
lay sleeping here.
Hm... This is...
A Rubble Guardian.

It may prove useful
in the battles to come.

This material... It's well worth
investigating.

I'll have it carried to the ship
at once.
Rubble Guardians can now be deployed.

I have received permission
from Emperor Galfa.

From now on, I too shall
accompany you.

You'll be joining us?
Now that's reassuring.

The mighty warrior Zero
has joined the unit.

rows.notes: [accuracy 5] direction: [jp] is Redros deciding to have it carried, not an order to Zero

segments.en:
Enemy fleet approaching GAIL Town!
They appear to have occupied the town!

So the enemy's target is the gate
after all...

No matter. Our work on this continent
has just about wrapped up anyway.

Take them on to your heart's
content!

rows.notes: [editorial 1] style sheet: 'gate' lowercase (common noun); 'after the Gate after all' doubled 'after'

segments.en:
Approaching GAIL Town.
The battle will now begin.

The enemy mobile force is a mixed unit.
Stay sharp!
I always am!
Let's go!!
Enemy mobile force destroyed!

However, the enemy's Infantry Squad
seems to be putting up
stubborn resistance.

What shall we do?
Shall we press on and take it?

The enemy's infantry is strong...
I'd rather not suffer needless losses.

We'll get the Infantry Squad ready to
go in, then make our move.

We'll take it in one fell swoop!
Send in the Infantry Squad!

We hold air superiority.
We'll take our time cooking them.

rows.notes: Segs 4-6 look like branch outcomes (prepare first vs. attack now); seg 4 has no header and may be a choice line -- kept as Binzvanker's speech that also reads as an option. | [editorial 1] UI term: [jp] = 'Infantry Squad' (capitalised, as in the rest of the corpus) | [editorial 4] UI term: [jp] = 'Infantry Squad' (capitalised, as in the rest of the corpus) | [editorial 5] UI term: [jp] = 'Infantry Squad' (capitalised, as in the rest of the corpus)

segments.en:
We will now send the Infantry Squad
into GAIL Town.

A cornered rat will bite the cat,
as they say! Show no mercy!

rows.notes: [editorial 0] UI term: [jp] = 'Infantry Squad' (capitalised, as in the rest of the corpus)

segments.en:
<Win Condition>
Destroy all enemy units

All enemy units destroyed.
Ending the battle.
The enemy offensive is over.

That concludes our operations
on this continent.
On to the other continents!
